source_refs.note: Roman Urdu guide to the Chapter 6 exercise (PDF 171-174; answer key PDF 226).

blocks.text: Exercise mein 18 MCQs, 9 short questions aur 8 long questions hain. MCQs ke sawal English tab mein kitab ki tarah diye gaye hain. Neeche ki table har MCQ ka sahi jawab, kitab ki answer key (kitab ka safha 223) aur woh topic batati hai jahan is ka jawab samjhaya gaya hai. Pehle khud hal karein, phir milayein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key (Unit 6, kitab ka safha 223) sirf pehle 10 MCQs ke jawab deti hai, aur un mein se chaar ghalat hain: MCQ 3 ka jawab (b) diya hai, sahi (c) hai (private cloud kam nahi balke zyada control deti hai); MCQ 4 ka (b) diya hai, sahi (c) hai (blockchain mein record aasani se badalna mumkin nahi); MCQ 5 ka (b) diya hai, sahi (d) hai (PaaS khud cloud service ki qism hai, BaaS teen bari qismon mein nahi); MCQ 7 ka (c) diya hai, sahi (b) hai (distributed ledger shurakaa kam karne ke liye nahi, sab ko data share aur verify karne ke liye hai).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: MCQ 15 ka jawab chapter ke text mein nahi: kai blockchains (jaise Bitcoin) Proof of Work istemal karte hain jis mein bohat se computers mushkil hisaab hal karte hain, is liye bijli bohat kharch hoti hai. Is liye jawab (b) High energy consumption hai. MCQ 2 ki 'Community Cloud' bhi chapter mein bayan nahi hui (dekhiye 6.2.3.3).
